queue.name: Property Intelligence Review Queue
queue.description: Frontend-only mock cases for reviewing conflicting property intelligence signals.

summary.headline: Ownership and sale-history signals disagree before outreach.
summary.recommendedNextStep: Resolve owner role and closing-date conflict before approving campaign use.

signals.title: Duplicate same-price sale events
signals.summary: Two adjacent sale events share the same price but disagree on date.
signals.recommendedAction: Verify canonical closing date before showing timeline.

signals.title: Owner role mismatch
signals.summary: The owner card and transaction chain point to different entities.
signals.recommendedAction: Normalize buyer, seller, and current-owner roles before outreach.

signals.title: Map marker hides value precision
signals.summary: The map marker shows exactly 1M while nearby markers preserve decimal precision.
signals.recommendedAction: Show one decimal above $1M unless the value rounds exactly to 1.0M.

signals.title: Exterior condition suggests repairs
signals.summary: Photo labels indicate worn exterior surfaces and possible deferred maintenance.

evidence.label: Photo tags
evidence.value: peeling paint, worn porch, overgrown yard

signals.recommendedAction: Request clearer exterior and roof photos before final pricing.

signals.title: Valuation confidence is moderate
signals.summary: Comparable signals are consistent enough to show an estimate with confidence language.
signals.recommendedAction: Display with confidence language rather than as a precise fact.

summary.headline: Large photo tour suggests extra spaces that listing facts do not explain.
summary.recommendedNextStep: Review basement, attic, and utility evidence before approving the space summary.

signals.title: Photo-derived spaces exceed listing facts
signals.summary: The tour includes basement, attic, stairs, sunroom, and utilities, but listing facts only describe a standard 4-bed layout.

evidence.label: Photo labels
evidence.value: basement, attic, water heater, gas meter, sunroom

signals.recommendedAction: Separate confirmed living spaces from support/utility spaces in the summary.

signals.title: Four-point conditions are mostly unknown
signals.summary: Roof, plumbing, and foundation conditions are unknown while HVAC has no clear recency signal.
signals.recommendedAction: Flag missing four-point condition evidence before underwriting.

signals.title: Low confidence valuation
signals.summary: The estimate should not be shown as a precise offer anchor because condition and space classification are unresolved.
signals.recommendedAction: Show a range and require manual review before outbound use.

summary.headline: Investment notes and property facts need a compact review pass.
summary.recommendedNextStep: Confirm unfinished garage-bedroom note before approving public-facing copy.

signals.title: Unfinished bedroom note affects room count
signals.summary: Seller notes mention an unfinished third bedroom in the garage, but canonical property facts show two bedrooms.
signals.recommendedAction: Keep canonical bedroom count at two unless the garage conversion is verified.

signals.title: Flood zone note is explicit
signals.summary: The notes identify Flood Zone X, which can be shown as a low-severity risk detail.
signals.recommendedAction: Display as supporting context, not a blocker.

signals.title: ARV has nearby comp support
signals.summary: Three nearby comps cluster around the stated after-repair value.
signals.recommendedAction: Show comp-backed ARV with source evidence.
